sources.title: Volvo Cars Hamilton (Ontario dealer) - Living with the 2026 Volvo EX40: range, charging and year-round capability
sources.notes: Canadian Volvo dealer article: up to 200 kW DC, 10-80% about 28 min, EX40 natively CCS, NACS adapter gives Supercharger access. Silent on heat pump, preconditioning and wheels.

sources.title: thinkEV Canada - Volvo EX30 Canada Review: Small, Safe, Swedish
sources.notes: Canadian review of the Single Motor and Twin Motor Performance: 153 kW peak, 10-80% about 26 min. Does not cover Cross Country; silent on port, trim heat pump, preconditioning and wheels.

sources.title: Polestar Canada - Tesla Supercharger network
sources.notes: States Polestar 2, 3 and 4 are compatible with the NACS adapter, ordered via a Polestar Service Point.

charge_port.notes: Quick web lookup. Canadian dealer article says the EX40 natively uses CCS (CCS1 for North America). Page says only 'CCS'; CCS1 inferred from the North American market.

supercharger_access.notes: Quick web lookup. Volvo's NACS adapter gives access to over 18,000 Tesla Supercharger stations in Canada and the US.
